rationale: Supplied mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowed files and preserved question schema. The proposal answers all five subquestions with 13 typed strategies, version-bound assessments, authentic-expression criteria, purpose-limited affect routing, privacy-preserving transparency and uncertainty-aware warnings. It correctly reuses UBU-D0347's communication limits and distinguishes enforceable authorization restrictions from advisory behavioral judgments. Adjacent policy questions remain open. The patch is detailed and somewhat repetitive, but directly scoped and auditable; no blocking defect was identified.
risks: Minimized harm-avoidance cautions could still influence persuasion indirectly; semantic exploitation judgments remain fallible.
The specified conformance fixtures have not been executed, so this establishes a product contract without implementation assurance.

rationale: Mechanical validation passed: the patch applies, touches only DECISIONS.md, DESIGN.md and OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, and the question block uses `Status: Solved` with `Resolved by: UBU-D0348` while leaving all other metadata and the question/subquestion text intact. The work is directly responsive: it answers all five subquestions (typed 13-code taxonomy with versioned per-type findings and review provenance; authentic-expression criteria that exclude assent prediction, susceptibility and simulated reactions as optimization targets; a purpose-limited affect firewall that permits deferral cautions but not receptive-moment or framing selection, with anti-laundering and context-routing enforcement; an epistemic transparency rule bound to choice-material assertions while protecting private notes; and uncertainty-aware advisory warnings with a concrete example) and it supplies the single-iteration policy by reusing UBU-D0347's communication ledger rather than duplicating it. It honours the question's current direction (harm avoidance yes, persuasion optimization no, advisory by default) and draws a useful line between enforced data-use restrictions and fallible semantic judgements. Cross-reference updates in §7.5, §22.3.1, §22.3.2 and §22.3.3 are the minimum needed to retire stale 'remains UBU-Q0098' pointers. Scope is correctly held: transition-type gates, pacing/support, general review UX and typed evidence policy are explicitly left with Q0096/Q0099/Q0101/Q0092, no new questions are opened, and requires_human_review is set to match the question's human-approval requirement. Deductions are for unverifiable alignment with the existing enum and referenced sections, the extension of the firewall to user-supplied affect data, and the density and fixture burden of the new section.
required_fixes: Before merge, confirm that the 13 codes in the new §22.3.4 table match the existing `prohibited_strategy_types` vocabulary in DESIGN.md §7.5 / UBU-D0155 name-for-name, or add a one-line note that the table is the canonical versioned list and the §7.5 enum defers to it.
risks: The decision asserts that UBU-D0155 and DESIGN.md §7.5 already define exactly these 13 strategy codes with these names; the diff does not touch the existing enum, so any mismatch between the new §22.3.4 table and the existing vocabulary would leave two divergent lists.

The firewall extends the harm-avoidance-only purpose limit to equivalent counterparty affect data supplied directly by the user or imports, which goes beyond the question's stated extrospection-derived scope and may be read as constraining the user's own notes; defensible as anti-laundering, but it is a product judgement that human review should confirm.

References to §17.0 log events (`decision_recorded`, `safeguard_advisory_bypassed`), §22.4 bypass semantics, and UBU-D0273 review flow are not verified in this score; a stale reference would weaken the contract's enforceability.

The new §22.3.4 is long and very dense, and the conformance paragraph demands paired fixtures for all 13 types plus firewall inspection; this is consistent with neighbouring §22.3.1–22.3.3 style but raises implementation cost and reading burden.
Clarifying that `prohibited_strategy_types` records applicable policy rather than detected strategies may subtly reinterpret the existing §7.5 field semantics if the current text implies detection.
